seo_title: AVRIX | Cyber Security for UK & European Businesses
seo_description: Penetration testing, 24/7 managed SOC, compliance (Cyber Essentials, ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2, DORA) and incident response for UK and European businesses.

sections.h1: Cyber security that keeps your business *open, compliant and trusted*
sections.lead: Penetration testing, 24/7 threat monitoring, compliance with UK and European standards, and rapid incident response, from one accountable team that explains everything in plain English.
sections.label: Illustrative security posture view

sections.title: Security services built around *your real risks*
sections.intro: Start with the problem you need solved. We bring the right specialists, from testing and monitoring to compliance and response.

sections.title: Sector know-how, *not one-size-fits-all*
sections.intro: Different industries face different attackers, regulators and pressures. Our approach starts with yours.

sections.title: Four disciplines. *One accountable team.*
sections.intro: Find weaknesses, watch for attacks, prove compliance and recover fast, joined up rather than bought from four suppliers.

sections.title: The standards your customers and regulators *ask about*
sections.intro: We help you meet the standards and regulations that UK and European customers, insurers and regulators ask for.

sections.title: What makes AVRIX *different*
sections.intro: Practical security work, honest reporting and help that doesn't stop at the report.

items.title: Manual, expert testing
items.text: Skilled testers go beyond automated scans to find the business logic and access control flaws that lead to real breaches.

items.title: Every finding confirmed
items.text: We verify issues before they reach your report, with clear evidence and step-by-step fixes your team can act on.

items.title: Free retesting
items.text: Once you've fixed the issues from a penetration test, we retest them and update your report at no extra cost.

items.title: One accountable team
items.text: Testing, monitoring, compliance and response from one team, with one point of contact and plain-English reporting.

sections.title: Five clear steps, *from first call to proof*
sections.intro: You always know what's happening, what's next and what you'll receive.

items.label: Stage 1
items.title: Free consultation and written scope
items.text: We understand your goals, agree what's in scope and confirm rules of engagement. Testing never starts without signed authorisation.

items.label: Stage 2
items.title: Hands-on testing and gap analysis
items.text: Our specialists test your systems or review your controls against the standards that matter to you.

items.label: Stage 3
items.title: Prioritised findings and walkthrough
items.text: A plain-English summary for leadership, technical detail for your team, and a call to agree priorities.

items.label: Stage 4
items.title: Fixes verified
items.text: We support your team through the fixes, then retest to confirm issues are closed.

items.label: Stage 5
items.title: Evidence for customers and auditors
items.text: Retest letters, compliance evidence and board-ready reporting you can share with confidence.

sections.title: Questions we're *often asked*
sections.intro: Straight answers on scoping, testing, compliance and incidents.

sections.title: Let's find your weak spots *before anyone else does*
sections.text: Tell us what you need to protect or prove. A specialist will reply within one working day with a clear next step.
